mapper.sql: subject_key, request_json, settings_json, state, fence, plan_json
mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM engine_delivery_schema_history WHERE version=3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO engine_feed_delivery(operation_id,subject_key,request_json,settings_json) VALUES (#{id},#{subject},#{requestJson},#{settingsJson}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE engine_feed_delivery SET fence=fence+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE operation_id=#{id} AND subject_key=#{subject} AND state='PREPARING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp()) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE engine_feed_delivery SET plan_json=#{planJson},state=#{state},updated_at=clock_timestamp(), lease_until=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds' END WHERE operation_id=#{id} AND subject_key=#{subject} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='PREPARING' AND plan_json IS NULL AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE engine_feed_delivery SET plan_json=#{planJson},state=#{state},updated_at=clock_timestamp(), lease_until=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds' END WHERE operation_id=#{id} AND subject_key=#{subject} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='PREPARING' AND plan_json=#{oldPlanJson} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
UPDATE engine_feed_delivery SET lease_until=NULL WHERE operation_id=#{id} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='PREPARING'
